name: Documentation
title: Templates/Shells/Documentation
summary: The documentation shell is `DocLayout`, composed once around the app's router view, so every docs page is only its article. The layout owns the chrome and the DOCUMENT scrolls: a sticky docs header (the Azion Docs mark, the section links from `sections`, the search field that opens the ⌘K palette of every navigation page, and the `actions` slot with the GitHub `IconButton` and the Console `Button`), a sticky navigation rail from `lg` built from the `navigation` data (groups of rows with in-app `href`s followed with the router, inline subsections as `children`) with the `ThemeSwitcher` in its `navigation-footer` slot and a drawer opened from the header below `lg`, the article in the layout's single main landmark, the sticky On this page rail from `xl` (the `outline` headings, tracked as the reader scrolls, plus the GitHub and Community `outline-groups`) with a `DocCta` in its `aside` slot, and the `Footer` (`kind="content"`) in the `footer` slot under the article, between the two rails; the primary's footer carries the columns, social links, status and language, with the brand leading the social row from `lg` (signature `compact`) and moving to the signature band below it, in CSS. No page wraps its article in a scroll area or a full-height frame. The primary's article is a short guide (`DocPageHeader`, then `DocProse` with `DocHeading` sections whose ids match the outline). Three variants fill the article from the documentation parts only: Article is a tutorial (First deploy) with breadcrumb, last updated and meta actions, a `DocCardGroup` chooser of paths, `DocCallout` tips, `DocSteps` with `CodeBlock` commands, a `DocPrompt`, Next steps, Related resources as `DocItem` rows in a `FrameBox`, and `DocPagination`; Reference is a product reference page (an info callout, two actions, the request path as a `Diagram` in a `DocFrame`, a JSON `CodeBlock`, a term list); Landing is the documentation home with the navigation rail but no outline rail: a `DocHero` with `Get started` and the `CopyPromptButton`, a `DocAgentCard` above the Console, CLI and API `DocCard`s, objectives, ready-made templates in their brand colours, Stop attacks, compliance, Follow along and the pager forward.
